description: This file contains unit tests for the OpenCdm module, which manages DRM sessions and system interactions. It uses Google Test framework to verify behaviors such as creating/destroying systems, constructing sessions, handling session metadata, and error conditions. The tests focus on the OpenCdm interface functions and mock dependencies, with specific attention to Widevine and PlayReady key systems.
